user.title: Connect your Condo Control account
user.description: Sign in with your resident account. Add each household member separately to give them their own device and package sensors.

property.title: Choose your condo
property.description: Choose a property linked to your account. You can add this account again to monitor another property. Leave the name blank to use your resident name. The property time zone is used for package arrival times.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Condo Control
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again with the same resident account for {name}.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Condo Control. Try again later.
error.invalid_auth: The credentials were rejected or access was denied.
error.invalid_response: Condo Control returned unexpected data. Please report this issue without including personal information.
error.packages_not_enabled: Package tracking is not enabled for this account at this property.
error.invalid_property: Choose a property from the list.
error.two_factor_required: This account requires two-factor authentication. This version does not support the verification flow yet.

abort.already_configured: This resident account and property are already configured.
abort.no_workspaces: There are no properties linked to this account.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: Sign in with the same resident account as the existing entry.

init.title: Package tracking options
init.description: All sensors for this account share one poll. The interval can be between 1 and 1440 minutes.
